verses.text: When all these things happen to you, the blessing and the curse I've set before you, remember them wherever the LORD your God has driven you among the nations.
Then you and your children will return to the LORD your God and listen to him with all your heart and all your soul, doing everything I'm commanding you today.
Then the LORD your God will free you from captivity, have compassion on you, and gather you back from all the peoples where he scattered you.
Even if your people have been driven to the farthest reaches under heaven, the LORD your God will gather you from there and bring you back.
The LORD your God will bring you into the land your ancestors owned, and it'll be yours. He'll do good to you and make you more numerous than your ancestors.
The LORD your God will circumcise your hearts and your descendants' hearts, so you'll love the LORD your God with all your heart and all your soul and live.
The LORD your God will put all these curses on your enemies, the people who hated and persecuted you.
You'll return and listen to the LORD and follow every command I'm giving you today.

The LORD your God will make all your work flourish and give you many children, thriving livestock, and abundant crops. The LORD will once again take joy in doing good for you, just as he took joy in doing good for your ancestors,
if you listen to the LORD your God, keep the commands and laws written in this book of the law, and turn to the LORD your God with all your heart and all your soul.
This command I'm giving you today is within your ability and within your reach.
It isn't up in heaven, where you'd have to ask, “Who'll go up to heaven for us, bring it back, and tell us what it says so we can do it?”
It isn't across the sea either, where you'd have to ask, “Who'll cross the sea for us, bring it back, and tell us what it says so we can do it?”
The word is right here with you, in your mouth and in your heart, so you can put it into practice.
Look, today I've put life and prosperity before you, along with death and disaster.

Today I'm commanding you to love the LORD your God, follow his ways, and keep his commands, laws, and rulings. Then you'll live and grow in number, and the LORD your God will bless you in the land you're going in to take as your own.
But if your heart turns away and you refuse to listen, and you let yourself be drawn away to worship and serve other gods,
I declare to you today that you'll certainly perish. You won't live long in the land you're crossing the Jordan to take as your own.
Today I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you. I've set life and death before you, the blessing and the curse. Choose life, so you and your descendants can live.

Love the LORD your God, listen to his voice, and hold on to him. He is your life and the one who gives you long days, so you can live in the land the LORD swore to give your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
